concerns.text: Task ID collision: T024 is assigned twice. First as a test for US2 (schema validation), then as an implementation task for US2 (suppressing generation for successes). This breaks the deterministic ordering and traceability required by FR-010 and the parallel execution model.

Missing producer task for US1 statistical verification. The Independent Test for US1 requires verifying a 'statistically significant performance drop (p < 0.05)', but no task exists to implement the statistical test logic (e.g., t-test) to produce this metric. T014 only logs a warning; the consumer (test) cannot run without the producer (statistical calculation).

Missing producer for US3 baseline condition. FR-003 requires executing the harness on 'both baseline (scalar reward) and counterfactual conditions'. T026 creates the harness class but does not explicitly include the task to implement the 'baseline' condition logic or the orchestration to run it. The analysis task (T029) cannot compare groups if the baseline data producer is missing.

T022 mentions 'deterministic rule mapping' but does not explicitly include the prerequisite task to load/parse the 'ground-truth environment rules' (JSON schema) defined in FR-002. The mapping logic cannot execute without the rule data producer.
